response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack/backend software craftsman with strong web, mobile, and systems-language breadth, but his profile is fundamentally mismatched to this role: no evidence of native or working Japanese, no Linux kernel investigation/modification experience, no embedded LAN-switch or networking security background (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF, SNMP), and his C/C++ experience is limited to an IDE tooling role and university-era projects rather than embedded UNIX systems work.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience across many stacks
Demonstrated systems-level programming experience with D (low-latency, async I/O, high-performance services)
Some historical C/C++ experience (LabWindows/CVI IDE components, embedded audio project)
concerns: No mention of Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement
No demonstrated Linux kernel source investigation/modification experience
No background in embedded networking/switch security domains (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF, SNMP, tamper detection)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded LAN-switch security experience
